thresholds.title: Alert Thresholds
thresholds.subtitle: Alerts fire when a value crosses its threshold. Settings are saved per vehicle.
thresholds.coolantTempDesc: Alert when engine coolant exceeds this temperature.
thresholds.batteryVoltageDesc: Alert when control module voltage drops below this level.
thresholds.fuelLevelDesc: Alert when fuel tank level drops below this percentage.
thresholds.resetConfirmMessage: Restore all thresholds to their default values?

welcome.title: Welcome to OBD-II AI
welcome.subtitle: Your AI-powered car diagnostic assistant. Let's get you set up in a few steps.
welcome.bleBody: This app uses Bluetooth to connect to your ELM327 OBD-II adapter. Please ensure Bluetooth is enabled.

pair.title: Connect Your Adapter
pair.subtitle: Scan for your ELM327 OBD-II adapter. Make sure it's plugged into your car's OBD port.

vin.title: Vehicle Identification
vin.subtitle: We'll read your VIN automatically from the ECU, or you can enter it manually.

language.title: Choose Language
language.subtitle: Select your preferred language. You can change this later from the home screen.
